messages:
maria_fin: Audit picked up 9 invoices with mismatched totals vs Stripe this morning. NetSuite shows lower amounts for those invoice_ids. Any webhook issues overnight?

dan_eng: ingest-bot shows a flurry of 502s to our netsuite-adapter at 00:45 UTC. connector retried the entire payload batch and acked before durable persistence, so some retry records were lost when worker recycled.

oliver_ops: confirmed worker recycle due to scheduled deploy during that window. supervisor restarted adapter and there was a short DLQ spike.

sue_fs: immediate exposure: 9 invoices, ~$1,920, two went to collections. finance requests CSV of stripe_event_ids + ns_invoice_ids and approval to post temporary credits so customers aren't charged incorrectly.

dan_eng: mitigation: flipped feature-flag to require durable write-before-ack for webhook relay and paused the scheduled deploy rollback. added a quick dedupe guard on event.id in the adapter.

maria_fin: please dump reconciliation CSV to /shared/finance/incident-2276543211/mismatch.csv and include a notes column "webhook-replay-gap". seeking ops approval for manual credits up to $2k.

oliver_ops: approved. add audit tag and notify collections to pause dunning for those accounts. :white_check_mark:

dan_eng: plan: 1) full backfill dry-run using event.id dedupe, 2) produce staging table for finance review, 3) apply fixes after signoff. ETA 4-5 hours.

ingest-bot: Alert: netsuite-adapter 502 error window 00:44:58-00:46:03 UTC, 74 retries recorded.

maria_fin: thanks. keep updates short here and post the CSV when ready.
